text: What is a Last Man Standing match in WWE? Rules and Crown Jewel 2026 bout. A Last Man Standing match in WWE is a professional wrestling bout that ends only when one competitor cannot continue, rather than by a pin or submission. At WWE Crown Jewel 2026 in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, Cody Rhodes and Randy Orton are set to meet in one.. WWE Crown Jewel 2026 is set for Saturday in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and its match card has been previewed with a focus on Roman Reigns and Sami Zayn. The Last Man Standing bout between Cody Rhodes and Randy Orton is part of that card.. The match is one of the bouts on the Crown Jewel card, which takes place on a Saturday in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Rhodes and Orton were teammates in The Legacy faction nearly two decades ago, when Rhodes was the pupil and Orton was the mentor. The Crown Jewel card also includes a main event between Roman Reigns, the Raw world champion, and Sami Zayn, the SmackDown world champion, and a women's title match between Liv Morgan and Chelsea Green. Morgan is one win away from becoming the only person to win a Crown Jewel title twice. Crown Jewel is the card where the bout is being promoted now, and it is also the reason the match is being discussed this week.

What is WWE Crown Jewel? Date, place and card for 2026. WWE Crown Jewel is a premium live professional wrestling event produced by WWE, the American wrestling company. The 2026 edition is set for Saturday, November 7, 2026, in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and features wrestlers from its Raw and SmackDown brands competing for championships.. A preview of the event highlights the Reigns and Zayn main event, which is one of the most closely watched matches on the 2026 card. Security questions over the Saudi Arabia location have also drawn coverage.. The 2026 show is the eighth Crown Jewel. It was first planned for the Riyadh Season Stadium, a temporary outdoor venue in the King Abdullah Financial District, but was moved indoors to the ANB Arena after security concerns. Coverage is listed for 8:00 p.m. Arabia Standard Time, which is the local time in Saudi Arabia. The main event pits Roman Reigns, the World Heavyweight Champion from Raw, against Sami Zayn, the Undisputed WWE Champion from SmackDown. Their rivalry dates to February 2023, when Zayn nearly beat Reigns at Elimination Chamber. Liv Morgan, the Women's World Champion, faces Chelsea Green, the WWE Women's Champion, who won her title in a ladder match this year. Cody Rhodes meets Randy Orton in a Last Man Standing match, and a world tag team title match is also on the card. The event has drawn attention beyond the ring. Reports describe safety concerns linked to a Riyadh airport attack, and some staff reportedly declined the trip. WWE has said it is going ahead with the show, which is set to take place weeks before Survivor Series: WarGames.

What does Undisputed WWE Champion mean? Title tied to Sami Zayn at Crown Jewel. "Undisputed WWE Champion" is a title used in wrestling for a wrestler who holds the top championship of WWE, the professional wrestling company, outright, with no rival belt claiming the same status.
